## Description

Chooses between passive limits and aggressive marketable orders using deviation from arrival price, urgency, volatility and remaining quantity.

## Where it may fit

Institutional execution where trading cost and completion risk must be balanced across a deadline.

## Vehicles

Institutional equity, futures, FX and crypto execution desks.

## Required data

Arrival mid/quote, real-time spread/depth, volatility, target quantity, remaining time, fill probability and benchmark prices.

## Caveats

Limit orders risk non-fill and adverse selection; market orders risk impact. Benchmark all fill models against realized implementation shortfall.
